goal: Prepare safe remote agent launch by proving live node readiness and exact blockers before any runtime mutation or broad fanout.
objective: Run a read-only first-wave probe on healthy server/control Agent Host nodes. Report deployed commit, Agent Host capabilities, Control Plane reachability, Factory Control route health, Telegram receiver ownership without mutation, GitHub/tooling readiness, dependency readiness, runner readiness classification, capacity gates, blockers, and exact gated follow-up tasks. Do not start or restart services, mutate Telegram, rotate credentials, merge PRs, push to main, or launch write-capable work.

known_blockers_to_recheck.signal: Live listeners returned HTTP 404 for PR #85 Fabric routes before later deploy-canary evidence.
Live entrypoint deploy failed on missing telegram_superfactory import and required rollback.
Telegram gateway inactive on probed node; no restart authorized.
GitHub PR metadata recheck was blocked where gh was unavailable.
httpx/dependency repair was blocked by externally managed Python.

required_node_checks: hostname, uptime, OS/kernel, time sync, CPU, memory, disk
Agent Host service/process state and advertised capabilities
Control Plane heartbeat freshness and lease reachability
repo path, branch, current commit, and dirty-state classification
Telegram receiver ownership classification without Bot API mutation
GitHub CLI/API/tooling availability without printing credentials
Node/frontend verification environment readiness where relevant
MIMO/Codex/API runner readiness classification without prompt, token, or env dumps
capacity gate for logical agents and safe subagent scheduling
acceptance: Remote execution happens on server/control nodes through Control Plane.
First wave is read-only/probe-only and does not mutate services, Telegram, credentials, GitHub PR state, or main.
Each node report includes exact live evidence or exact blocker classification.
Factory Control, Telegram, runner, dependency, and capacity gates are recorded separately.
Any mutation-oriented follow-up is emitted as a separate gated task recommendation.
Exact canonical run artifacts and intelligence artifacts are created.
